title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Planner Agent for planning and managing work
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing and documented control routes are supported. The group-access explanation needs a correction: a valid security group ID does not enable access unless AllowPlannerCopilot is also true. The audit checklist also needs to distinguish a planned capability from a control shown in the table.

claims.claim: Planner Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot helps users plan, organise and manage work.
claims.quote: Planner agent in Microsoft 365 will help you plan, organize, and manage work more efficiently.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes core task and plan management features as the starting capability.
claims.quote: We’re starting with core task and plan management features to simplify project tracking

claims.claim: Microsoft plans additional advanced project management capabilities over time.
claims.quote: will introduce additional advanced project management capabilities over time.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes Planner Agent as automating plan creation and task execution for teams.
claims.quote: The Planner Agent automates plan creation and task execution for teams.

claims.claim: The cited Planner pages describe Planner behaviour rather than detailing the Microsoft Copilot experience.
claims.quote: Searched: '516576 Planner', 'Planner Agent Microsoft Copilot data privacy permissions approval tasks actions'; opened planner/turn-off-planner-agent and planner/planner-for-admins. Their stated scope is Planner; Cowork plugin results describe a different experience.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the feature-specific default for Planner Agent in Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Planner Agent Microsoft Copilot default enabled automatically admin center restrict Planner AllowPlannerCopilot UI', 'Planner Agent Copilot default'; opened turn-off-planner-agent and manage-copilot-agents-integrated-apps. General agent defaults do not state this agent's initial assignment.

claims.claim: Planner Agent works on plan and task content.
claims.quote: The Planner Agent automates plan creation and task execution for teams.

claims.claim: Planner Agent and its chat are built on Microsoft's security, compliance and privacy approach.
claims.quote: Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat in premium plans are built on Microsoft’s comprehensive approach to security, compliance, and privacy.

claims.claim: The Planner Agent page does not publish a data-boundary statement specific to its Microsoft Copilot surface.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Planner Agent Microsoft Copilot data privacy permissions approval tasks actions'; opened turn-off-planner-agent and read Copilot privacy search excerpts. General Copilot protections are documented, but no separate boundary for this Planner Agent surface was stated.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance guidance: At rollout; rendered controls table
claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false disables Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat in Planner.
claims.quote:
To turn off Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for all users:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false

claims.claim: An admin UI equivalent of the Planner-specific AllowPlannerCopilot control is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Planner Agent Microsoft Copilot default enabled automatically admin center restrict Planner AllowPlannerCopilot UI', 'Planner Agent admin center PowerShell'; opened turn-off-planner-agent and agent management pages. Planner instructions give PowerShell; Copilot agent management is separate.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Scope; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Planner tenant admin PowerShell commands require a global admin.
claims.quote: You must be a global admin to run the Planner Tenant Admin Powershell Commands.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Planner access can be restricted to a Microsoft Entra security group using -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId.
claims.quote:
Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>
Ensure the Security Group ID is valid and corresponds to an existing group in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: An invalid security group ID denies access to all users.
claims.quote: If the Security Group ID is invalid, no users will have access, even if AllowPlannerCopilot is set to $true.

claims.claim: A valid security group ID turns the feature on for those users only.
claims.quote:
| $false | Not applicable | 'OFF' for all users |
| $true | valid security group ID | 'ON' for users in the security group only (or nested members) |
claims.fix: Replace the sentence with: 'Planner PowerShell: when AllowPlannerCopilot is $true, a valid security group ID restricts access to that group's users, including nested members; an invalid group ID denies access to all users.' The behavior matrix at https://learn.microsoft.com/planner/turn-off-planner-agent also states that $false disables access regardless of the group ID.

claims.claim: Planner PowerShell policy changes may take up to an hour to apply.
claims.quote: Changes may take up to 1 hour to reflect across your organization.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The cited Planner pages do not name Planner Agent as a separate purchase or state a separate price.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Planner Agent Microsoft 365 Copilot price meter licensing Copilot Credits'; opened planner-for-admins and turn-off-planner-agent. Both name Microsoft Copilot licensing; neither names a separate Planner Agent purchase or price.

claims.claim: The pages checked do not publish a price or meter specific to Planner Agent in Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Planner Agent Microsoft 365 Copilot price meter licensing Copilot Credits'; opened Planner licensing pages and read Copilot Credits billing/search excerpts. Those describe general meters and other agent classes, not a Planner Agent-specific meter.

claims.claim: The Planner Agent in Planner page covers basic and premium plans.
claims.quote: the Planner Agent experience for task execution and status reporting in both basic and premium plans

claims.claim: The same page documents Planner Agent chat for premium plans only.
claims.quote: as well as the Planner Agent chat in premium plans only.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; rendered controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: An administrator reaches an agent's Block action through Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block.
claims.quote:
Select Agents > All agents.
In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents.
In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.

claims.claim: POST /beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block blocks a Copilot package to prevent usage.
claims.quote:
Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Governance guidance: At rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The admin center Block action restricts access to the selected agent across the organisation.
claims.quote: Block and unblock | Restrict access to an agent across the organization, preventing any user from using it.

claims.where: controls[0].note; controls[1].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The Planner page directs admins to Microsoft 365 agent management for Planner Agent in Microsoft Copilot, separately from its Planner PowerShell instructions.
claims.quote: For information on how to manage the Planner Agent in Microsoft Copilot, please see Manage agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/admin/manage-copilot-agents-integrated-apps to sources with title 'Manage agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center'. This is the intervening page linked by the Planner article; it identifies Microsoft agents as manageable and links to agent governance.

claims.claim: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 licence.
claims.quote: Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license.

claims.claim: The block call uses the beta API.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: The Planner Agent documentation checked does not state whether every action in this Copilot experience requires approval.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Planner Agent approval', 'Planner Agent Microsoft Copilot data privacy permissions approval tasks actions'; opened turn-off-planner-agent and read approval results. Planner Plugin in Cowork documents approval, but does not establish this separate agent's approval model.

claims.claim: Get-PlannerConfiguration verifies AllowPlannerCopilot and PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId.
claims.quote:
To verify your settings, run the following command:
Get-PlannerConfiguration
AllowPlannerCopilot: True or False
PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId: Displays the Security Group ID when these features are turned on for your organization

claims.claim: Learn says Planner Agent plans to provide the auditing capabilities of Planner premium plans.
claims.quote: Planner Agent plans to provide the same auditing capabilities as premium plans (previously Project for the Web projects).

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to watch Planner Premium audit log activities, but the controls table has no audit row.

Watch Planner Premium audit log activities, which Learn says Planner Agent plans to match.
The controls table lists only Planner availability and organisation-wide agent blocking.
claims.fix: Remove the 'Watch Planner Premium audit log activities' checklist bullet: it has no corresponding control row, and the cited Planner Agent page describes matching auditing as planned. Keep the existing audit question in Open questions.
